items.subject: Gym tools: what studies say about lifting straps, a lifting belt and resistance bands
items.idea_from: owner 2026-11-20: today's Reel about gym tools and their benefits from real studies, matching the products in his bio; made in his chat

affiliate.product: Lifting straps, weightlifting belt, resistance bands
affiliate.caption_line: 🔗 الأدوات في المقطع (أحزمة المعصم، وحزام الرفع، وأشرطة المقاومة): روابطها في البايو.

items.hook_idea: ثلاث أدوات في الجيم: هل تفيدك فعلًا؟
claims: In 20 men, the deadlift one-repetition maximum was about 10% higher with lifting straps than without (177.0 vs 160.6 kg on average).
In 10 resistance-trained women, lifting straps allowed more deadlift repetitions at 80% 1RM without lowering bar velocity, and grip strength dropped less.
In 14 healthy men squatting at 90% 1RM, the lift was faster with a weight belt, with no difference in thigh, hip or lower-back muscle activity.
A systematic review and meta-analysis of 8 studies found similar strength gains from elastic resistance training and conventional resistance training.
seed_sources: Jukic I et al., J Strength Cond Res, 2020
Trahey KM et al., J Strength Cond Res, 2023
Zink AJ et al., J Strength Cond Res, 2001
Lopes JSS et al., SAGE Open Med, 2019
